title: seL4 verification proofs
summary: The upstream l4v repository contains Isabelle/HOL specifications and proofs for the seL4 microkernel. Consult upstream documentation for configurations and proof coverage.
assumptions: Proof claims depend on the architecture, configuration, specifications, and trusted components documented upstream.
limitations: The commons has not independently reproduced the l4v proof builds.
A project link does not establish verification of every seL4 configuration, driver, hardware platform, or caller.

license.attribution: README and license documentation: Copyright 2020 Data61, CSIRO, CC-BY-SA-4.0. Proofs and tools have per-file licenses, typically GPL-2.0-only or BSD-2-Clause; inspect file headers before reuse.

reuse: Start with the pinned upstream README and proof coverage documentation; retain all configuration assumptions and inspect per-file license notices.

opportunities: Report proof or documentation issues upstream.
Use seL4's documented contributor process for changes.
